replies.author: @Mustangofold
replies.text:
Based off of the stories that have come out about this from the participants, youtubers, and some news stories this is what supposedly happened.
The OG Manager got it rung through at no tip with no problems...apparently they did not want to see if it was real or not while the person was present and would have had to authorize it?
The regular found out, checked with the card company, and then froze the card to prevent shenannigans.
Somehow OG then tried to run a $699 charge with no card on hand that got declined after the card was frozen.
They fired her the next day.

They claim it was due to poor performeance, multiple warnings, and her reaction.  Supposedly "anonymous co-workers" immediately start4ed speaking up claiming that she was horrible at her job, published a mugshot of a girl with the same name from an arrest a few years earlier in a different state, sent out screen shots of supposed text messages claiming that the regular was an Ex of hers and was trying to run a scam of some kind on the restaurant, etc.
Her side has put out some screen shots of text messages as well but have kept to the same story about what happened.

Either version is bad and just damages OG's reputation.
The nightmare version is if the running the card later for a different amount, without the card present, is true.  That should land the manager, and any staff involved in doing it, and anyone from corporate involved in it, in prison, along with massive corporate fines.
